unit.label: People, hotels & reasons
unit.title: The One in Blue
unit.description: Continue this lesson through people and hotel descriptions: identify people with modifying clauses, describe changes with sentence-final 了, express direction with 往, and connect causes and effects with 因為…所以….

goal.text: 因為現在去玩的人比較少，所以旅館不太貴。
goal.pinyin: Yīnwèi xiànzài qù wán de rén bǐjiào shǎo, suǒyǐ lǚguǎn bú tài guì.
goal.meaning: Because fewer people are traveling now, the hotel is not too expensive.

unit.bookReference: A Course in Contemporary Chinese 1 · Lesson 10 Dialogue II / Vocabulary II (printed pp. 205–207) and Grammar III–V (printed pp. 210–213). 窗戶 is explicitly deferred because 窗 and 戶 lack verified Taiwan Traditional handwriting geometry in the project's licensed source path.

lessons.title: Last Month at a Hotel
lessons.subtitle: Use 旅館, 太太, and 住 in one hotel context; 上個月 is a transparent time phrase.

steps.prompt: Which word means hotel?
steps.explanation: 旅館 is hotel/inn; 茶館 is a tea house.

steps.prompt: Which verb means live or stay at a place?
steps.explanation: 住 means live/stay.

steps.prompt: In 旅館老闆的太太, who is 太太?
steps.explanation: 太太 means wife in this this lesson context.

lessons.title: Tall, Short, and Who?
lessons.subtitle: Use 男 + noun, 矮, 高, and 弟弟 to distinguish people.

steps.prompt: Which word means younger brother?
steps.explanation: 弟弟 means younger brother.

steps.prompt: Which pair contrasts height?
steps.explanation: 高 is tall/high; 矮 is short in height.

steps.prompt: What does 男 do in 男學生?
steps.explanation: this lesson presents 男 + noun as a male-person expression.

lessons.title: The Photos I Took
lessons.subtitle: Use 這些 and put a complete identifying clause before 的 + noun.

steps.prompt: In 我拍的照片, what does 我拍 do?
options: It is the clause identifying which photos
It means the photos are red
steps.answer: It is the clause identifying which photos
steps.explanation: The clause 我拍 comes before 的 + 照片.

steps.prompt: Can a clause before 的 be negative?
options: Yes, e.g. 不去夜市的人
No, only affirmative clauses can modify nouns
Only color words can appear before 的
steps.answer: Yes, e.g. 不去夜市的人
steps.explanation: this lesson explicitly gives negative modifying clauses.

lessons.title: Clean, Blue, and Different Now
lessons.subtitle: Describe 乾淨 and 藍色, then use final 了 for a genuine change of situation.

steps.prompt: What does sentence-final 了 signal in 我現在喜歡吃水果了?
options: A changed situation or new state
steps.answer: A changed situation or new state
steps.explanation: The preference is now different from before; final 了 is not simply past tense.

steps.prompt: Which sentence means 'I don't live/stay here anymore'?
steps.explanation: 不住 gives the new negative state, and final 了 marks the change.

lessons.title: Looking Out the Window
lessons.subtitle: Use the conversation’s 從窗戶往外看 to contrast the starting viewpoint 從 with directional 往.

steps.prompt: In 從窗戶往外看, which word marks the outward direction?
steps.explanation: 從 marks the starting viewpoint; 往 marks direction, here 往外 'outward'.

steps.prompt: Which phrase means “look out from the window”?
steps.explanation: 從窗戶 sets the viewpoint at the window and 往外看 means look outward.

lessons.title: Because… So…
lessons.subtitle: Put the cause first with 因為 and the effect second with 所以.

steps.prompt: Which clause gives the cause in 因為…所以…?
steps.explanation: 因為 introduces why something happens; 所以 introduces the result.

steps.prompt: Which order matches this lesson?
options: effect + 因為 + cause + 所以
steps.explanation: this lesson presents cause first and effect second, normally with the pair 因為…所以….

lessons.title: Unit 31 Review
lessons.subtitle: Hotels, people, modifying clauses, changed situations, directions, and reasons.

steps.explanation: 住 is zhù, live/stay.
矮 is ǎi, short in height.
因 is yīn, the first character of 因為.

steps.prompt: Which movement-related component is on the left of 往?
steps.explanation: 往 has 彳 on the left and 主 on the right.

steps.prompt: In 上個月我住在旅館, which word means “hotel”?
steps.explanation: 旅館 is hotel/inn; 上個月 means last month.

steps.prompt: Which word means wife in this this lesson context?
steps.explanation: 太太 means wife here.

steps.prompt: Which sentence says his younger brother is tall?
steps.explanation: 弟弟 means younger brother, while 太太 means wife; 高 means tall.

steps.prompt: Which sentence correctly describes a male student as shorter?
steps.explanation: 男學生 means male student; 比較矮 means comparatively shorter.

steps.prompt: Which word means 'these'?
steps.explanation: 這些 means these; 這裡 means here.

steps.prompt: Which sentence says these are the clothes she wears?
steps.explanation: 她穿 is the modifying clause before 的 + 衣服; 這些 means these.

steps.prompt: Which phrase means “people who do not go to the night market”?
steps.explanation: 不去夜市 modifies 人. 人不去的夜市 can mean a night market that people do not go to; it modifies a different noun.

steps.prompt: Which matching set is correct?
options: 窗戶 = window; 乾淨 = clean; 藍色 = blue
窗戶 = hotel; 乾淨 = blue; 藍色 = clean
窗戶 = clothes; 乾淨 = tall; 藍色 = red
steps.answer: 窗戶 = window; 乾淨 = clean; 藍色 = blue
steps.explanation: 窗戶 is window, 乾淨 is clean, and 藍色 is blue—the three descriptions used around the hotel scene.

steps.prompt: Which sentence clearly uses final 了 for a changed situation?
steps.explanation: Final 了 tells us the preference is now different from before.

steps.prompt: Which sentence means 'I no longer stay/live here'?
steps.explanation: The negative is the new state, and final 了 marks the change.

steps.prompt: In 從窗戶往外看, which word marks the outward direction?
steps.explanation: 往 marks the direction of the action; 從 marks the starting viewpoint.

steps.prompt: Which question asks whether the changed situation now holds?
options: 你現在喜歡吃水果了嗎？
steps.answer: 你現在喜歡吃水果了嗎？
steps.explanation: Final 了 before 嗎 asks whether the new situation now applies, rather than simply asking about a current or past preference.

steps.prompt: Which word introduces the cause?
steps.explanation: 因為 introduces the reason/cause.

steps.prompt: In 因為…所以…, which clause comes first?
options: The cause introduced by 因為
The effect introduced by 所以
Either order is taught as identical here
steps.answer: The cause introduced by 因為
steps.explanation: this lesson teaches cause first, then effect.

tokens: 因為現在去玩的人比較少

steps.prompt: Fewer people are traveling, which makes the hotel less expensive. Which sentence preserves that cause and result?
options: 因為現在去玩的人比較少，所以旅館不太貴。
因為旅館不太貴，所以現在去玩的人比較少。
現在去玩的人比較少，但是旅館很貴。
steps.answer: 因為現在去玩的人比較少，所以旅館不太貴。
steps.explanation: 因為 introduces fewer travelers as the cause; 所以 introduces the hotel price as the result. The second option is structurally possible but reverses the given causal relationship.

this lesson pairs 因為 with the already familiar 所以 to express cause before effect.

住.note: 住 is fourth-tone zhù. In this lesson it means to stay at a hotel or live somewhere.
住.memory: 亻 takes the first two strokes on the left; 主 fills the right with a dot above three horizontals crossed by a vertical.

parts.label: 亻
parts.name: person component
parts.description: The first two strokes form the narrow person component 亻.

parts.label: 主
parts.name: right component
parts.description: The final five strokes form 主 on the right.

男.note: 男 is second-tone nán. this lesson uses 男 before another noun, such as 男學生.
男.memory: 田 forms the five-stroke top; 力 adds the two-stroke lower part.

parts.label: 田
parts.name: field component
parts.description: The first five strokes form 田 at the top.

parts.label: 力
parts.name: strength component
parts.description: The final two strokes form 力 underneath.

矮.note: 矮 is third-tone ǎi and describes a person's short height.
矮.memory: 矢 makes the five-stroke left side; 委 makes the eight-stroke right side with 禾 above 女.

parts.label: 矢
parts.name: arrow component
parts.description: The first five strokes form 矢 on the left.

parts.label: 委
parts.name: right component
parts.description: The final eight strokes form 委 on the right, with 禾 above 女.

弟.note: 弟 is fourth-tone dì. The family word 弟弟 repeats it and means younger brother.
弟.memory: Two 丷 dots sit at the top; the lower five-stroke body bends through a bow-like center and finishes with a left sweep.

parts.label: 丷
parts.name: top dots
parts.description: The first two strokes form the paired 丷 top.

parts.label: 𢎨
parts.name: lower body
parts.description: The final five strokes form the bent lower body of 弟.

些.note: 些 is first-tone xiē. With 這, it forms 這些, 'these.'
些.memory: 此 forms the six-stroke upper body; two horizontal strokes 二 sit underneath.

parts.label: 此
parts.name: upper component
parts.description: The first six strokes form 此 across the top.

parts.label: 二
parts.name: two component
parts.description: The final two horizontal strokes form 二 underneath.

乾.meaning: dry; first character of 乾淨
乾.note: 乾 is first-tone gān in 乾淨, 'clean.' This unit teaches it as part of that word.
乾.memory: The dense eight-stroke 𠦝 group occupies the left; compact 乞 uses the final three strokes on the right.

parts.label: 𠦝
parts.name: left component
parts.description: The first eight strokes build the compact left side 𠦝.

parts.label: 乞
parts.name: right component
parts.description: The final three strokes form 乞 on the right.

淨.note: 淨 is fourth-tone jìng. Together with 乾 it forms 乾淨, 'clean.'
淨.memory: Three water dots 氵 stand on the left; 爭 supplies the eight-stroke right side.

parts.label: 氵
parts.name: water component
parts.description: The first three strokes form 氵 on the left.

parts.label: 爭
parts.name: right component
parts.description: The final eight strokes form 爭 on the right.

藍.note: 藍 is second-tone lán. With 色 it forms 藍色, blue.
藍.memory: The four-stroke 艹 top sits above the dense fourteen-stroke 監 body.

parts.label: 艹
parts.name: grass component
parts.description: The first four strokes form the Traditional 艹 top.

parts.label: 監
parts.name: lower component
parts.description: The final fourteen strokes form 監 beneath the grass top.

往.note: 往 is third-tone wǎng. It introduces direction; the conversation uses 從窗戶往外看, look outward from the window.
往.memory: 彳 takes three narrow walking strokes on the left; 主 fills the right with five strokes.

parts.label: 彳
parts.name: step component
parts.description: The first three strokes form 彳, a movement-related component.

parts.label: 主
parts.name: right component
parts.description: The final five strokes form 主 on the right.

因.partOrderLabel: outer frame begins, 大 goes inside, then the frame closes
因.note: 因 is first-tone yīn. In 因為, it introduces a cause.
因.memory: The outer 囗 begins first, 大 is written inside it, and the last horizontal closes the enclosure.

parts.label: 囗
parts.name: enclosure component
parts.description: Strokes 1–2 begin the outer enclosure and the final stroke closes its bottom.

parts.label: 大
parts.name: big component
parts.description: The middle three strokes form 大 inside the enclosure before the box closes.

窗.note: 窗 is first-tone chuāng. Learn it with 戶 as 窗戶, window.
窗.memory: The five-stroke 穴 roof sits above the seven-stroke lower 囱-shaped body.

parts.label: 穴
parts.name: cave/roof component
parts.description: The first five strokes form 穴 across the top.

parts.label: 囱
parts.name: lower window-shaped body
parts.description: The final seven strokes form the enclosed lower body beneath 穴.

戶.meaning: door; household; second character of 窗戶
戶.note: 戶 is fourth-tone hù. In 窗戶, the whole word means window.
戶.memory: 戶 is a compact four-stroke form with a top stroke and a broad sloping lower shape; keep the left side open and tall.

parts.label: 戶
parts.name: whole character
parts.description: All four strokes form the independent Traditional character 戶.

u31-clause-modifier.title: Use a whole clause to identify a noun
u31-clause-modifier.explanation: A complete clause can modify a noun in Chinese. Put the modifying clause before the noun and place 的 directly before that noun. The modifying clause can be affirmative or negative. This lets you say things such as 'the photos I took,' 'the person wearing red clothes,' or 'people who do not go to the night market.'

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shì wǒ pāi de zhàopiàn.
examples.meaning: These are the photos I took.

examples.text: 穿紅色衣服的人是我朋友。
examples.pinyin: Chuān hóngsè yīfú de rén shì wǒ péngyǒu.
examples.meaning: The person wearing red clothes is my friend.

examples.text: 不去夜市的人可以在家喝茶。
examples.pinyin: Bú qù yèshì de rén kěyǐ zài jiā hē chá.
examples.meaning: People who do not go to the night market can drink tea at home.

u31-clause-modifier.remember: Put the entire description before 的 + noun. Negative clauses work too.

u31-sentential-le.title: Mark a changed situation with sentence-final 了
u31-sentential-le.explanation: Sentence-final 了 marks that the situation is now different from before; it is not simply a past-tense marker. The sentence may be affirmative, negative, or a question. In a negative change such as 我不住這裡了, the negation describes the new state: 'I no longer stay/live here.' In a question, 了嗎 asks whether the changed situation now holds.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài xǐhuān chī shuǐguǒ le.
examples.meaning: I have come to like eating fruit now.

examples.text: 你現在喜歡吃水果了嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiànzài xǐhuān chī shuǐguǒ le ma?
examples.meaning: Do you like eating fruit now (unlike before)?

u31-sentential-le.remember: Final 了 signals a new situation compared with before. Do not translate it mechanically as past tense.

u31-yinwei-suoyi.title: Give a reason with 因為…所以…
u31-yinwei-suoyi.explanation: 因為 introduces the cause and 所以 introduces the result. In the this lesson pattern, the cause comes first and the two conjunctions normally appear as a pair. Keep the logic clear: the 因為-clause explains why the 所以-clause follows.

examples.text: 因為現在去玩的人比較少，所以旅館不太貴。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi xiànzài qù wán de rén bǐjiào shǎo, suǒyǐ lǚguǎn bú tài guì.
examples.meaning: Because fewer people are traveling now, the hotel is not too expensive.

examples.text: 因為我喜歡水果，所以我想吃吃看。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ xǐhuān shuǐguǒ, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng chīchīkàn.
examples.meaning: Because I like fruit, I want to try it.

u31-yinwei-suoyi.remember: Cause first with 因為; effect second with 所以.

u31-wife.meaning: The hotel owner's wife is very happy.

u31-brother.note: 弟弟 is younger brother; 高 is the height description tall.

u31-short-man.note: 男 + noun marks a male person; 比較 gives an implicit comparison.

u31-these-photos.pinyin: Zhèxiē shì wǒ pāi de zhàopiàn.

u31-red-person.text: 穿紅色衣服的人是我朋友。
u31-red-person.pinyin: Chuān hóngsè yīfú de rén shì wǒ péngyǒu.
u31-red-person.meaning: The person wearing red clothes is my friend.
u31-red-person.note: 穿紅色衣服 modifies 人.

u31-negative-person.text: 不去夜市的人可以在家喝茶。
u31-negative-person.pinyin: Bú qù yèshì de rén kěyǐ zài jiā hē chá.
u31-negative-person.meaning: People who do not go to the night market can drink tea at home.
u31-negative-person.note: The modifying clause can be negative.

u31-clean.note: 乾淨 is the state description clean.

u31-now-like.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài xǐhuān chī shuǐguǒ le.
u31-now-like.meaning: I have come to like eating fruit now.
u31-now-like.note: Final 了 marks a changed preference.

u31-no-longer.meaning: I don't live or stay here anymore.
u31-no-longer.note: The negative describes the new situation; final 了 marks the change.

u31-toward.text: 從窗戶往外看，是藍色的大海。
u31-toward.pinyin: Cóng chuānghù wǎng wài kàn, shì lánsè de dàhǎi.
u31-toward.meaning: Looking out from the window, you see the blue sea.
u31-toward.note: This is the the conversation wording: 從 introduces the viewpoint/source, 往外 gives the outward direction, and 窗戶 is the window.

u31-because.text: 因為現在去玩的人比較少，所以旅館不太貴。
u31-because.pinyin: Yīnwèi xiànzài qù wán de rén bǐjiào shǎo, suǒyǐ lǚguǎn bú tài guì.
u31-because.meaning: Because fewer people are traveling now, the hotel is not too expensive.
u31-because.note: The 因為 clause gives the cause; the 所以 clause gives the effect. 現在去玩的人 also reviews a clause modifying 人.
